controllerType: Integrated LCD electronic control (built into machine head, blue panel)
type: K4-UT electromechanical integrated small square head high speed computer stretch sewing machine (interlock)
note: K4-UT is Jack's first integrated stretch sewing machine — the electronic control is built directly into the machine head (no separate under-table box). UT suffix = Electric automatic thread trimming. UL = Electric auto trim (no cutting), UTL = Pneumatic auto trim. Voice navigation with Chinese/English/multilingual support. Based on 8669BDII/35AC(UT) model.

specs.panelKeys: Reset | Voice switch | Lifting foot mode | LED+trimming switch | Cursor keys (◄/►) | Speed control (+/-) | P (parameter setting)
specs.monitoringAccess: Press P + Lifting foot key together to enter detection mode
specs.factoryResetMethod: Long press Reset button 1.5s to restore user-saved parameters; press Left + Right together 1.5s to restore full factory defaults

errorCodes.cause: System under voltage — input supply voltage too low (less than 176V)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power and check if input supply voltage is low (<176V). Restart controller after voltage returns to normal. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Stop over voltage — input supply voltage too high (more than 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power and check if input supply voltage is high (>264V). Restart controller after voltage returns to normal. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Runtime over voltage — supply voltage too high during operation
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power and check input supply voltage. Restart after voltage returns to normal. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Electromagnet circuit failure — connection loose, disconnected, or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check if the electromagnet connection is correct, if it is loose or damaged. If damaged, replace it in time. Restart after confirming correct. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Current detection loop failure — circuit fault
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power and turn back on after 30 seconds. Retry several times. If the fault occurs frequently, replace the controller. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor stalled — machine head stuck or motor plug/sensor connection loose
errorCodes.solution: Check whether machine head is stuck or not, or rotates very tough. Check whether motor plug and sensor connection are loose or not. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Brake circuit failure — white brake resistor connector on power board loose
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check if the white brake resistor connector on the power board is loose or not plugged in. Plug in and restart. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: HMI communication failure — control panel and controller connection disconnected, loose, or broken
errorCodes.solution: Check if the connection between the control panel and the controller is disconnected, loose, or broken, and return to normal before restarting the system. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Head stop signal failure — synchronization signal device connection loose or faulty
errorCodes.solution: Check if the connection between the head synchronization signal device and the controller is loose; return to normal and restart. If still does not work properly, replace the controller. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor initial angle detection failure — angle calibration failed
errorCodes.solution: Try again 2-3 times after power off. If the fault still reports, replace the controller. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor HALL failure — motor sensor connector disconnected, loose, or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check if the motor sensor connector is disconnected, loose, or damaged. Return to normal and restart. If still does not work properly, replace the controller. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: DSP read and write EEPROM failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn back on after 30 seconds. If still does not work properly, replace the controller. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn back on after 30 seconds. If still does not work properly, replace the controller. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

alarmCodes.meaning: Counting number alarm — needle count has reached upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press P to cancel the alarm and recount.

alarmCodes.meaning: Counting number alarm — cut line count has reached upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press P to cancel the alarm and recount.

alarmCodes.meaning: Power failure reminder — abnormal power loss detected
alarmCodes.solution: Please wait 30 seconds before turning the power switch back on.

alarmCodes.meaning: Safety switch alarm — thread cutter not in place or safety switch not detecting correctly
alarmCodes.solution: Check if the thread cutter is in place. If the safety switch light does not illuminate after returning to position, adjust the position of the sensor bracket. If cannot be solved, set P66 parameter from 2 to 0. If cannot solve, contact local agent or call 4008876858.

monitoring.note: Requirement: 340°±5°. If out of range, adjust P302 then use P62=2 to remeasure

monitoring.name: Mechanical angle
monitoring.note: Used to set upper needle stop position (see section 3.3)

troubleshooting.symptom: Check/calibrate motor initial angle (motor angle at 023 not 340°±5°)
checks: Long press P key to enter parameter 062 (or open machine and press P key to enter parameter 143)
Adjust parameter from 0 to 2 to save
Lightly step on pedal; after motor stops rotating, press P key + lift foot button to enter monitoring mode
Check monitor 023 — requirement is 340 degrees ±5 degrees
If out of range, change parameter 302 to adjust the value displayed in monitor 023
After change, set P62 (or 143) parameter from 2 to 0; restart the electronic control to check normal running
If parameter 302 was adjusted, press P to save parameters

troubleshooting.symptom: Upper needle stop position incorrect (needle bar not stopping at highest point)
checks: Press P key + presser key to enter monitoring mode; adjust to monitor 024
Turn handwheel clockwise to stop needle bar at highest position (do not turn back and forth)
Press P key + scissors key when parameter display value is 0
Step on pedal to check if needle is at highest position
If adjusted correctly, press and hold right arrow key for 3 seconds to save parameters

troubleshooting.symptom: ARM UP safety switch alarm that won't clear
checks: Check if thread cutter is in correct position
If safety switch light does not illuminate after returning to position, adjust sensor bracket position
If adjustment fails, set P66 parameter from 2 to 0 to disable safety switch function temporarily
Contact local service agent or call 4008876858 if still cannot resolve

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-08 motor stalled on K4-UT interlock machine
checks: Check if machine head is stuck or difficult to rotate by hand
Check machine head lubrication — interlock machines require regular oiling
Check if motor plug (10-core cable) is loose or disconnected
Check if motor sensor connector is firmly seated
Verify sewing material is not too thick for the machine's capacity
Try rotating handwheel manually to check for mechanical binding
